text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN TENDER - Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group will tender on Thursday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of corn, traders said on Tuesday.

The CCC said it was tendering on April 22 for a total of up to 9,690 tonnes of U.S. corn for export to Kenya and Angola, May 5-31 shipment. The total comprised up to 5,000 tonnes for Angola and up to 4,690 tonnes for Kenya.
SORGHUM TENDER - The CCC said it would tender on April 22 for up to 5,000 tonnes of U.S. sorghum for export to Kenya, May 5-31 shipment.

BARLEY TENDER - Turkey's state grain board will seek bids for an international tender on April 29 to export 100,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley, a senior official said on Monday.
WHEAT TENDER - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association on Tuesday passed on a tender for two 34,000-tonne U.S. wheat shipments due to high prices, traders said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq will tender on April 18 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat, several U.S. exporters said. The wheat will be slated for June arrival. Nearly 300,000 tonnes of wheat have arrived in Iraq under its Oil-for-Food deal with the United Nations, the Iraqi government newspaper al-Jumhouriya said on Sunday.

- CCC said it was seeking up to 7,220 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat, maximum moisture 13.5 percent, under the export program for Bosnia. The shipment period was set for May 7-31 and offers were due April 21.
WHEAT TENDERS - Syria offered 50,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for June shipment. Bids were due April 15.
- USDA's Commodity Credit Corp said it would tender April 15 to buy 25,470 tonnes dark northern spring wheat for donation to Ghana. The wheat was due for May 1-25 shipment.
RICE TENDERS - Costa Rica will be tendering on April 16 for 26,500 tonnes optional origin long grain rough rice or 18,000 tonnes long grain milled rice.
- South Korea is expected to hold a tender at the end of June to buy 77,000 tonnes of rice to meet its 1997 quota under the World Trade Organization, U.S. Agriculture officials said.

MARKET TALK - The Philippine National Food Authority has approved the importation of 350,000 tonnes of yellow corn either from the United States or Argentina, NFA administrator Joemarie Gerochi told reporters on Tuesday.
... The United States on Tuesday announced $15 million in additional food aid to famine-threatened North Korea.
